items.statement: No requester is permitted to approve their own purchase request.

source_units.text: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.

items.statement: Before automatic payment, an invoice needs either an existing purchase order or a receipt record; either alone suffices.

source_units.text: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment.
